title: designing a robust extreme gradient boosting model with shap-based interpretation for predicting carbonation depth in recycled aggregate concrete
core_idea: Develop a predictive framework for carbonation penetration depth in recycled aggregate concrete using eight machine learning algorithms (NGBoost, GBRT, AdaBoost, CatBoost, XGBoost, LightGBM, HistGBRT, MLR), evaluate models with four performance metrics, and use SHAP for interpretability while testing six input parameter configurations.
tldr: Apply and compare multiple ML/ensemble models with SHAP-based interpretation to predict carbonation depth in recycled aggregate concrete and assess effects of different input configurations using standard performance metrics.
